coverage.evidence: Supplied sources are the OBS page Required overlays list (FirstPartyWidgetCatalogue.cs:60-70, RequiredOverlaysPanel.vue, obs/i18n/en.json:29,40) and are kept off the Overlays list (OverlaysView.vue:56-61). A new overlay starts with IsEnabled = true (WidgetService.cs:122), and so does a copy (WidgetService.cs:243). Each copy is a new Widget row with its own id and its own OverlayToken (Widget.cs:111), and the address is built per widget (WidgetService.cs:1785-1786).

A settings save publishes WidgetSettingsChangedEvent (WidgetService.cs:522-531), which is pushed to the open overlay (WidgetBuildLifecycleHandler.cs:29-38) and applied in place (OverlaySdkController.cs:472). A successful build publishes WidgetBuildSucceededEvent (WidgetService.cs:1083-1093), which becomes ReloadWidgetAsync (WidgetBuildLifecycleHandler.cs:40-48); the page gives the visible result as the editor.compiled string (overlays/i18n/en.json:59). A test goes to the one widget, only if it is on and subscribed, and reports delivered and attached (WidgetTestEventController.cs:113-136, WidgetAlertRouting.cs:25). Delete removes the row (WidgetService.cs:556-558), and the dialog text says it stops in every browser source (en.json:17).

The levels are one row per channel (ChannelAudioMixService.cs:70-81) and open from the page header behind sounds:read (OverlaysView.vue:117,175). Sliders are disabled without sounds:write, and a level saves on value-commit, blur or Enter, with no Save button (AudioMixPanel.vue:56,186,198-199). Master volume scales sound clips (IChannelAudioMixService.cs:66-67, SoundClipService.cs:365) and TTS (IChannelAudioMixService.cs:70); no music code reads it. Voice volume is ttsVolume, and the duck default is 100, meaning no ducking (AudioMixDefaults.cs:30, TtsSpeakBroadcastHandler.cs:59).

reader_answers.evidence: The sidebar entry Overlays needs widget:read (navigation.ts:217-220, locales/en.json:846). New overlay, Name, Code language (default vue) and Create overlay come from NewOverlayDialog.vue:37,75-102 and en.json:10,21-33. The new overlay opens through @created (OverlaysView.vue:106-111,181). An address exists at once because OverlayUrl is always built (WidgetService.cs:1917). The copy button reads Address copied (OverlayDetail.vue copyAddress, en.json:144-145), and the address is never printed.

widget:write defaults to Moderator (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:396), with LeadModerator, Editor and Broadcaster above it (PermissionLevel.cs:26-29). widget:read can be lowered to VIP (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:395). New overlay is disabled with common.readOnly without widget:write (OverlaysView.vue:123). frameworkHelp says the code language cannot change (en.json:29).

The dialog closes and emits created (NewOverlayDialog.vue:67-68), and IsEnabled = true (WidgetService.cs:122). The green dot is overlayHealth ok when on and attached with no error (overlayHealth.ts:18-27). The row text is list.attached (OverlayRow.vue:36-40), and the Health note is attachedNote, Events reach your stream (OverlayDetail.vue attachLine, en.json:157-158).

Duplicate calls widgets/clone with installedWidgetId (widgets.ts:278-291). The clone is a new detached custom widget named Copy of plus the original name, with copied settings, IsEnabled = true and its own token (WidgetService.cs:232-246, Widget.cs:111). It is refused with WIDGET_NO_SOURCE when the original has no saved source version (WidgetService.cs:217-223), and the error shows under the footer (OverlayDetail.vue copyOverlay and InlineNotice after EditorFooter).
